counter_commitments.applies_to: Anthropic's mainline, general-access Claude models, as described by Claude's Constitution (no version stated)
counter_commitments.quote: For example, if Claude was taught to follow a rule like “Always recommend professional help when discussing emotional topics” even in unusual cases where this isn’t in the person’s interest, it risks generalizing to “I am the kind of entity that cares more about covering myself than meeting the needs of the person in front of me,” which is a trait that could generalize poorly.
